sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-12,800 (levels 1-20). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Gutshot T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice, vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike. Ultimate (Ira Domini) is available from Battle Vest.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Melee Charge
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Battle Vest
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Point Blank completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Point Blank completes 6.4k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 12,800-27,200 (levels 20-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Hex-Lined Snap Trap T3, Ira Domini T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Hex-Lined Snap Trap, damage) grows from 126 to 247. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Greater Expansion.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Gutshot: takes 18% off its 13s base cooldown.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Greater Expansion, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.caption: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 195s; 20% off is 39s per full rotation. Upgrade of Compress Cooldown (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Greater Expansion completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 19 to 45 spirit power. +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Gutshot wall stun distance (7m), Consecrating Grenade radius (4.5m), Consecrating Grenade burn radius (4.5m).

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you. Takes vitality from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Gutshot: resets its 13s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Warp Stone? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.
sections.desc: Dying after Warp Stone? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their carry outshoots you before you reach them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keeping you from reaching them.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They chain stuns on you every time you go in.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Ira Domini gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (145s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
